description: V0.5c development evaluation, Stage A (integration: one seed, 7 days, every model) (docs/benchmark/v05c-dev/PLAN.md): the frozen LLM agent with local models beside the no-op baseline on the bundled sustainable scenario, daily decisions at 07:00. A development comparison, not a benchmark result: no composite score, no ranking. Run from the repository root with DREAMTEAM_LLM_BASE_URL set.

None appears elsewhere in the repository; not a reference seed (1001-1020), not a V0.2 development seed (901-910), not drawn from any reserved stream; the sealed holdout guard accepts them.
